summary: Google offers eligible college students 1 year of Gemini subscription free. US students get Google AI Pro; students in 140+ countries get Google AI Plus. This is a back-to-school promotion announced by the official Gemini App account.
claim_steps: Verify your student status through your school's email or enrollment system.
Visit gemini.google.com and sign in with your verified student account.
The free 1-year subscription applies automatically to your account.

social_proof.author: Gemini
social_proof.text: Back-to-school season is here and starting today, eligible college students can get a full year of Gemini on us: US students: 1 year of Google AI Pro at no cost. 140+ countries: 1 year of Google AI Plus at no cost.
